The main takeaway from our work is that

the Portugal Current is a major player in the ventilation of ENACWs of subtropical origin in the eastern North Atlantic, and that this ventilation is not restricted to the shelf break, but also extends offshore.
the Portugal Current System plays a key role in the ventilation of ENACWs.

the Portugal Coastal Countrecurrent is not a direct pathway for the ventilation of the subtropical ENACW, and thus, it is not the main mechanism for its downstream ventilation, but it is a pathway for the transport of low oxygen/high nutrient waters to the slope.
